name: USB Audio Speaker
description: The `usb_audio` speaker platform plays audio on a USB audio device, such as a USB sound card, DAC or speakerphone, connected to the [USB Audio](https://esphome.io/components/usb_audio/) component.

config_entries.label: Audio DAC
config_entries.description: The [audio DAC](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/) to use for volume control. Can also be a list of audio DAC IDs that all receive this speaker's audio. Every audio DAC in the list gets the same volume and mute. Each audio DAC can only be listed once.

config_entries.label: USB Audio ID
config_entries.description: The [USB Audio](https://esphome.io/components/usb_audio/) component to use. Defaults to the only one in YAML.

config_entries.label: Bits Per Sample
config_entries.description: The bit depth of the audio samples. One of `8bit`, `16bit`, `24bit` or `32bit`. Must be supported by the USB device. Defaults to `16bit`.

config_entries.label: Buffer Size
config_entries.description: The size of the buffer between ESPHome and the USB driver, in bytes. Must hold at least two USB transfers (6 ms of audio, e.g. `1152` bytes at 48000 Hz, 16 bit, stereo). Defaults to `6400`, or to the minimum when that is larger.

config_entries.label: Num Channels
config_entries.description: The number of channels, `1` (mono) or `2` (stereo). Must be supported by the USB device. Defaults to `2`.

config_entries.label: Sample Rate
config_entries.description: The sample rate of the audio stream, in Hz. Must be between `8000` and `96000` and supported by the USB device. Defaults to `48000`.

config_entries.label: Write Timeout
config_entries.description: The maximum time a write waits for room in the buffer. Defaults to `20ms`.
